authority_if_any_v4_gate_fails.required_next_action: Freeze the first V4 result; any changed target selection, query cascade, team equivalence, name key, tiebreak, timeout, threshold, source, or retry behavior requires a new preregistered version.

query_cascade.name: exact_visible_name
query_cascade.rule: Fill exact source visible_name and press Enter once.

query_cascade.condition: Only if prior response is HTTP 200 parseable players array with length 0 and stripping one terminal suffix token changes the query.
query_cascade.name: terminal_suffix_stripped
query_cascade.rule: Remove exactly one terminal suffix token and surrounding whitespace; press Enter once.

query_cascade.condition: Only if every prior response is HTTP 200 parseable players array with length 0.
query_cascade.name: surname_only
query_cascade.rule: From the suffix-stripped source visible_name, use the final whitespace-delimited token after trimming punctuation at token edges; minimum 3 alphanumeric characters; press Enter once.

browser_transport.stop_rule: Stop at the first HTTP 200 parseable players array with length > 0. Do not broaden after a nonempty players array even if semantic resolution fails.

conditional_capability_evidence.ari_az_team_alias_qualified_only_if: All four preregistered team_alias_ari_stratum targets resolve uniquely under ARI<->AZ equivalence and every overall V4 gate passes.
conditional_capability_evidence.multiple_candidate_tiebreak_qualified_on: At least one V4 target has >1 primary candidate and the frozen position+jersey tiebreak resolves exactly one valid GSIS; otherwise tiebreak semantics remain unqualified even if V4 overall passes.
conditional_capability_evidence.query_fallback_semantics_qualified_only_: At least one V4 target requires attempt 2 or 3 and then resolves uniquely under the frozen semantic rule; otherwise fallback semantics remain unqualified even if V4 overall passes.

fixed_resolution_rule.candidate_name_match: candidate name_key(displayName) must equal target name_key(visible_name)
fixed_resolution_rule.multiple_candidate_tiebreak: If more than one primary candidate exists, require target jersey_number to parse as integer and target position uppercase to equal candidate position uppercase OR positionGroup uppercase; require candidate jerseyNumber/uniformNumber integer to equal target jersey; keep only candidates satisfying both position and jersey. Resolve only if exactly one remains and its gsisId is valid.
fixed_resolution_rule.name_key: Unicode NFKD; ASCII-drop; lowercase; replace maximal non-[a-z0-9] runs with spaces; trim/collapse; remove one terminal generational suffix token jr/sr/ii/iii/iv/v; if the normalized name begins with two or more consecutive one-letter alphabetic tokens, compact that leading run into one token. No other token deletion, transposition, stemming, nickname, phonetic, or fuzzy rule.
fixed_resolution_rule.primary_candidate_set: Candidates satisfying candidate_name_match and frozen team_equivalence.
fixed_resolution_rule.single_candidate_rule: If exactly one primary candidate exists and gsisId matches ^00-[0-9]{7}$, resolve it.

governance.next_phase_after_pass: Separately preregister a point-in-time inactive/availability identity application. V4 itself cannot authorize availability, player-value joins, forecast effects, model fitting, or production. Any target application row requiring an unobserved conditional fallback/tiebreak capability must remain unresolved.

purpose: Prospective out-of-sample validation of narrowly repaired official-roster-to-NGS GSIS resolution after V3 showed browser transport succeeds but the V2 semantic resolver misses source/NGS team-code aliases, exact-query-empty names, and same-name same-team collisions. V4 may use V3 only as development evidence; its 74 validation targets are selected mechanically from frozen official roster metadata and exclude every V1 sentinel and every V2/V3 target row before any V4 NGS request.

coverage_stratum.rule: For each team in lexicographic team order, sort eligible rows by selection_key ascending, visible_name ascending, profile_path ascending; take first 2.

source_name_variant_stratum.rule: Take rows whose visible_name matches either frozen source-only regex; sort by selection_key, team, visible_name, profile_path; take first 16.

team_alias_ari_stratum.rule: Sort eligible ARI rows by the same frozen ordering and take first 4.

target_selection.union_rule: Row-identity union of coverage_stratum, team_alias_ari_stratum, and source_name_variant_stratum.
